strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚⋯⋯{NEWLINE}难道是电话⋯⋯坏了么？{SCROLL}你从别的地方{NEWLINE}再打一个过来吧⋯⋯
strings.en: Huh? Wha...? I can’t hear you.{NEWLINE}Maybe we’ve got a bad connection.{SCROLL}Go somewhere else and try{NEWLINE}calling again!

strings.zh: 喂喂！{NEWLINE}不好意思,我习惯这么大声了！{SCROLL}你最近身体怎么样！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello?!{NEWLINE}Oh, sorry, I’m just used to shouting!{SCROLL}How’ve you been?!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 除了我之外还有其他{NEWLINE}厉害的道馆馆主吧？{CLEAR}你就尽力去打败他们吧！
strings.en: There are other tough Gym Leaders{NEWLINE}besides me, right? Give it everything{CLEAR}you’ve got and beat them!
strings.notes: US 0656/3 | RV071: meaning: no 'stronger than me'; 'beat them' restored (D-1896)

strings.zh: 对了,我在{NEWLINE}星期三的晚上有空闲,{CLEAR}到时候你可以打电话给我！
strings.en: Let’s see... I’m free most Wednesday{NEWLINE}nights. Give me a call then, OK?

strings.zh: 哦！我刚才正好{NEWLINE}结束了训练,{CLEAR}和我来对战一场如何？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Oh hey! I just finished training.{NEWLINE}Do you want to battle again? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 很好！{SCROLL}那我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你！
strings.en: Great!{SCROLL}Then I’ll be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier!
strings.notes: Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 嗯⋯⋯你现在{NEWLINE}还有时间和我战斗吗？{SCROLL}你不是和别的人{NEWLINE}也有预约了么？
strings.en: Hmm... Do you even have time to battle{NEWLINE}me right now? Don’t you have plans with{CLEAR}someone else too?
strings.notes: US 0656/8 | RV071: meaning: zh asks whether you have time

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋等你。{CLEAR}我非常期待。
strings.en: I’ll be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier. I can’t wait!
strings.notes: Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 我们不是约好了在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋对战的吗？{CLEAR}难道你忘了？{CLEAR}一定要来啊！
strings.en: Didn’t we agree to battle{NEWLINE}at the Trainer House at the{CLEAR}Battle Frontier? Don’t tell me{CLEAR}you forgot! You’d better come!
strings.notes: US 0656/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 你应该知道{NEWLINE}我每天都在进行{CLEAR}承受瀑布冲击的修行吧？{SCROLL}因此我家老太婆{NEWLINE}天天都替我担心。{SCROLL}过几天,我准备{NEWLINE}带她去旅行,{CLEAR}就当是向她赔罪了。{CLEAR}可惜,最近一直都没有时间。{SCROLL}⋯⋯对了！{SCROLL}去东城瀑布怎么样？
strings.en: You know I train under a pounding{NEWLINE}waterfall every day, right?{SCROLL}My old lady worries about me{NEWLINE}every single day because of it.{SCROLL}So I’m planning to take her on a trip{NEWLINE}soon to make it up to her. Trouble{CLEAR}is, I haven’t had any time lately.{SCROLL}...I know!{SCROLL}How about Tohjo Falls?

strings.zh: 告诉你个秘密,{NEWLINE}其实我⋯⋯{CLEAR}非常喜欢吃甜食。{SCROLL}每次结束修行后,{NEWLINE}我都偷偷背着我老婆{CLEAR}吃甜品。{CLEAR}真是人生一大享受啊！{SCROLL}但正因此,我肚子上{NEWLINE}长了一圈的赘肉⋯⋯{SCROLL}对了！这件事可{NEWLINE}千万别告诉我老婆啊！
strings.en: I’ll tell you a secret.{NEWLINE}The truth is, I...{SCROLL}I really love sweets.{SCROLL}Every time I finish training, I sneak{NEWLINE}something sweet behind my wife’s back.{CLEAR}It’s one of life’s great pleasures!{SCROLL}But it’s given me a nice ring{NEWLINE}of flab around the belly...{SCROLL}Oh! Whatever you do, don’t tell my wife!

strings.zh: 最近道馆的瀑布设备{NEWLINE}有点问⋯⋯哇！{SCROLL}哗啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦{NEWLINE}啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦{CLEAR}啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦{CLEAR}啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦啦⋯⋯{SCROLL}⋯⋯不好意思,{NEWLINE}刚才那个装置又坏了,{CLEAR}水喷了出来。{SCROLL}等我修好它之后{NEWLINE}再给你回个电话！
strings.en: Lately my Gym’s waterfall device has{NEWLINE}had a bit of a probl... Waaah!{SCROLL}Boomwhooshoowhooshoowhoosh{CLEAR}oowhooshoowhooshoowhoosh{CLEAR}oowhooshoowhooshoowhoosh...!{SCROLL}...Sorry about that. The device just{NEWLINE}broke again and water came{CLEAR}spraying out.{SCROLL}I’ll call you back once I’ve fixed it!
strings.notes: US 0656/14 | RV071: meaning: device broke 'again'; 'once I've fixed it' (D-1897); removed added panting
